GCTS_certification.cluster: Pending family receptors are obligations, not facts. Validate a proposed body by expansion to current legal original keys, then commit through the reference scheduler with a proved transaction or one-member advice. No family-only candidate list supplies domain cardinality.
GCTS_certification.many: Two distinct legal keys certify degree at least two; they do not certify the exact degree. This suffices only with a separately declared canonical tie policy inside the earliest generation. If preserving current minimum-count tie policy, derive/check exact MDD counts; do not silently substitute saturated counts.
GCTS_certification.one: One exact legal key plus a complete cover proving every other ground key illegal/excluded. Merely finding the first key is not a forced move.
GCTS_certification.scheduler: Certify global no-dead and no-forced across every frontier point before earliest-generation branching. A later cheap certificate does not outrank an earlier obligation. Complete base fallback remains after advice; exact rollback restores domains/region states/selected keys/totals/mark refcounts/generations/exclusions/cursors.
GCTS_certification.unresolved: Any frontier point still possibly zero or singleton blocks a reference branch decision; pause UNKNOWN. No heuristic or family proposal can fill that evidence gap.
GCTS_certification.zero: Every disjoint binding-region remainder is exhausted or eliminated by an independently checkable original t/m/signature/capture/strict-prior conflict. One failed sampled binding proves nothing about a region.

language.binder_policy: Initially preserve literal binder names and deterministic capture-renaming used by existing checking. Do not introduce an unproved alpha-equivalence quotient. Any finite binder namespace and fresh-name ceiling belong in the new declaration.
language.bounded_hull: Declare term bound B, formula bound N, atomic-context bound C, binder namespace and height H before outcomes. Construct the least formula/rule hull from all named axioms, indexed Gamma and target-as-syntax; universally include every admissible primitive instance, every literal subformula/subterm, new UI of any admitted universal, UG and MP, repeating until no new instance remains. Admissibility checks EVERY resulting witness/formula term against B and formula size against N, not merely its substitution input. Thus any term exposed by a declared admissible instance is already a first-class member of T_B; no late target-selected pool patch or search-dependent model growth.
language.finiteness: The finite AST/binder bounds make the declared hull finite; they restrict the encoding and are reported. A failed count/construction/time bound yields UNKNOWN, never silently trims an instance or substitutes a smaller favorable hull.
language.legacy_inclusion: Before accepting a successor for an existing theory, prove every original formula and original (primitive witness, ordered premises) has a literal image in the new hull, including terms previously exposed outside the old operand pool. Choose bounds sufficient for this check or reject the successor. Fresh declaration/authority/registry/model epochs are required; old IDs/codes are provenance plus an explicit mapping, not falsely unchanged new identities.
language.old_profiles: Current Q1717 open-parameter and Hilbert3b6 ground endpoints remain distinct until a new shared adapter/kernel has independently passed both exact contexts. A common wire does not make current graph/checker ABIs interchangeable.
language.profile_limit: Initial common fragment is the existing six primitive rules, not a claim of complete FOL. Hilbert incidence/order/congruence/etc are input axioms only after separately declared authority. Point/line names remain theory predicates/guards unless a future separately verified sorted kernel is introduced.
language.shared_AST: Retain literal var/fun/eq/pred/all/connective AST and strict typed scalars, capture-safe substitution, ordered MP and original-Gamma UG side condition. Logical rule identities and witness construction stay independent of arithmetic or geometric symbol names.
